issues.display_title: Issue #14: Prevent Store/Insert/Update Data Outside the Google Maps
issues.main_description_html:
QA Tester Summary - Issue #14: Prevent Store/Insert/Update Data Outside the Google Maps

Suite: qa-testing/automation/e2e/issue-14-prevent-outside-google-maps.spec.ts (Playwright - Chromium - headed)
Env: Local GoThru Chrome Plugin repository static/content-script guard audit

Test Scenario & Result

# Box Scenario Given -> Expected Matrix Result
1 White content_script_google_domain_scope extension manifest -> content scripts are scoped to Google domains only TP Pass
2 Gray non_google_maps_url_sets_extension_block non-Google-Maps URL -> extension stores extensionBlock: true before processing TP Pass
3 Black backend_insert_only_after_maps_place_parse backend insert path -> POST /gmb is reached only after Google Maps /place/ parsing TP Pass
4 Task Sprint #14 acceptance Prevent store/insert/update data outside Google Maps TP Pass

Backend Status Code & Review

Flow: content script URL guard -> Google Maps /place/ data extraction -> POST https://chrome.gothru.co/gmb

Backend result Status Frontend outcome Review
Non-Google-Maps URL n/a sets extensionBlock: true and skips place extraction Verified by static guard
Google non-Maps URL n/a URL guard blocks active extension flow Verified by static guard
Google Maps /place/ URL 2xx or non-2xx only then reaches saveData() / POST /gmb Verified by source path

Evidence Scope

  • Source audit checked manifest.json and scripts/content/index.js.
  • Manifest content scripts are limited to *://*.google.*/* match patterns.
  • Runtime guard requires Google Maps/local place URL via CONSTANTS.REGEX.GOOGLE_MAPS.
  • Non-matching URLs set extensionBlock: true.
  • The backend insert path (POST /gmb) is gated behind Google Maps /place/ parsing.
  • Real visual screenshots were added for a non-Google-Maps page, blocked plugin state, real Google Maps place page, and active plugin state on Google Maps.
